alyssa ng: FYI — console analytics seems to ignore the model alias + region selection. I pick alias 'ggml-jumbo:quant' and region 'ap-northeast-1' but the charts show global totals.

samir p: Can you drop the exact console URL + time range?

alyssa ng: URL: /console/metrics?range=24h&region=ap-northeast-1&model=ggml-jumbo%3Aquant
Snapshot of the request/response from network tab: 
```
GET /api/v1/metrics?start=2026-03-15T00:00Z&end=2026-03-16T00:00Z&region=ap-northeast-1&model_alias=ggml-jumbo:quant
Response:
{ "model_id": "ggml-jumbo", "region": "global", "total_tokens": 1234567 }
```

dinesh k: I can repro in incognito. Frontend sends the alias param correctly but backend returns aggregated/global region. Looks like the response is normalizing alias -> canonical id and dropping region scoping. Assigning to eng-frontend and eng-platform to triage.

support-bot: Created incident INC-2026-314 with severity P2 and linked tickets.

ingrid v: Does this have billing impact? A couple customers pinged that console numbers don't match invoices.

samir p: Quick repro steps I ran:
1) open Console -> Metrics -> set range last 24h
2) Model dropdown -> pick "ggml-jumbo:quant" alias
3) Region selector -> pick "ap-northeast-1"
4) Observe chart doesn't change, network shows payload: {"region":"ap-northeast-1","model_alias":"ggml-jumbo:quant"} but server response has "region":"global"

Example request/response (copied raw):
```
Request payload: {"region":"ap-northeast-1","model_alias":"ggml-jumbo:quant","granularity":"1h"}
Response: {"model_id":"ggml-jumbo","region":"global","series":[...],"totals":{"tokens":1234567}}
```

dinesh k: Found root cause: recent alias-service migration changed the expected region param name from `region` -> `region_tag`. Backend code that maps alias to canonical model id only understands `region_tag` now, so when alias resolution runs it returns model metrics without region filtering. I'll push a fallback in 5-10m to accept either param.

samir p: Patch PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4521 — added fallback and unit test. Rolling to staging now.

alyssa ng: On staging the ap-northeast-1 numbers look correct now, counts match raw logs. :thumbsup:

ingrid v: Excellent. Can support pull a list of accounts that viewed the affected dashboard in last 48h so we can proactively message? Also draft a short note explaining what happened and that estimates in console were overstated for some alias+region combos.

product-ops: We'll prepare the customer message and coordinate with finance if any invoice adjustments are needed.

support-bot: Linked support tickets: SUP-482, SUP-483. Notifying owners.

samir p: Follow-up TODOs: (1) add integration test covering alias+region filtering, (2) add observability to alias-service for dropped region tags, (3) run backfill to flag dashboards that may have shown wrong aggregates.

dinesh k: Adding the integration test now. Creating a short postmortem draft in /docs/incidents once we close INC-2026-314.

alyssa ng: Thanks all — leaving logs and screenshots in the incident thread. If any customers escalate, ping me and I'll jump on the call.
